scope.chapter: Normal Modal Logic — Syntax and Semantics

findings.finding: The proof calls M-prime a model after specifying V-prime only on p_i; a model valuation must be defined on all propositional variables.
findings.controlling_evidence: The frozen relational-model definition makes V total on propositional variables. Assigning V-prime(q)=V(q) on variables outside the replaced list completes the valuation without changing the displayed substitution claim, since those variables are not replaced.
findings.required_translation_handling: State the unchanged valuation on other variables adjacent to the construction and disclose the completion, leaving the frozen English source unchanged.
